beats.say: This is AI Use Case Prioritization. It helps you choose where AI is worth the effort first, and names the first pilot to run.
Name your list, so you can find it later.
beats.label: Name it

beats.say: Every idea answers five questions: business value, data readiness, cost and effort, team readiness, and risk if it goes wrong. Each one is scored from one to five.
beats.label: Five questions

beats.say: Add your ideas, one per row, as specific as you can. Fill in an example to see it work.
beats.label: Score your ideas

beats.say: The map plots value against feasibility. Quick wins sit top right. Strategic bets are valuable but harder. A dashed ring flags high risk.
beats.label: Where they land

beats.say: Your plan ranks every idea with a next step, and Start here names the first pilot: one team, four to six weeks, and one number to judge it by.
beats.label: Your plan

beats.say: Save it to your account, share a link, or export a CSV or PDF. Prefer a spreadsheet? There's an Excel version with the same math.
beats.label: Save, share, export

beats.say: Score it with the people who'd use it, pilot one thing at a time, and re-run it after each pilot. That's the tour.
beats.label: Make it stick
